_doc: CA NH muni obligor universe at 2017-12-31 → outcomes through 2019-12-31. Pre-COVID 'normal cycle' baseline test. Universe includes obligors that subsequently defaulted/closed.
_universe_construction_methodology: Same anti-survivorship-bias methodology as nh_stressed_2019_2022 — include all CA SNF muni obligors active 2017-12-31. Key historical context: Daughters of Charity → Verity transition occurred Dec 2015; Verity entered Ch 11 Aug 2018, MID-WINDOW. This makes Verity a CRITICAL test case for framework: pre-default signal at 2017-12-31 should be detectable (BlueMountain leverage event 2015 = MA precursor, hospital operating losses already known).
_caveats: Window does NOT include COVID stress — pure normal-cycle test.
Verity BK is the ONE major bond default in window — framework's ability to flag it at 2017-12-31 is the key test of pre-event detector signal.
CMS Star Ratings used PRE-April-2019 methodology throughout this window — different from current Five-Star methodology. Pre-2019 staffing rating used PBJ-based MDS data weighted differently.
Most obligors in window had non-events — this is by design (normal cycle baseline).
